say:1:1721216001:1.text: Good timing, Magister. We've only just finished with Baron Grandet.
say:1:1721216001:1.source_cn: 阁下，您来得正好。对葛朗台男爵的审讯刚刚结束。
say:1:1721216001:1.male: Good timing, Magister. We've only just finished with Baron Grandet.
say:1:1721216001:1.female: Good timing, Magister. We've only just finished with Baron Grandet.

choice_prompt:2:1721216001.female: Good timing, Magister. We've only just finished with Baron Grandet.

say:3:1721216002:1.text: He folded almost immediately. The moment we sat him down, the whole story came pouring out.
say:3:1721216002:1.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵吓破了胆，审讯刚开始就一股脑把交易过程全说了出来。
say:3:1721216002:1.male: He folded almost immediately. The moment we sat him down, the whole story came pouring out.
say:3:1721216002:1.female: He folded almost immediately. The moment we sat him down, the whole story came pouring out.

say:4:1721216003:1.text: He swears he had no idea. Says he genuinely believed it was the real thing, paid a fortune for it, and thought presenting it to the royal family would earn him a little glory.
say:4:1721216003:1.source_cn: 他一口咬定自己真的不知情，从头到尾都以为这是条真正的神...
say:4:1721216003:1.male: He swears he had no idea. Says he genuinely believed it was the real thing, paid a fortune for it, and thought presenting it to the royal family would earn him a little glory.
say:4:1721216003:1.female: He swears he had no idea. Says he genuinely believed it was the real thing, paid a fortune for it, and thought presenting it to the royal family would earn him a little glory.

say:5:1721216004:1.text: As for the reporters and the ceremony, according to him, that was just Grandet being Grandet. He wanted attention, wanted people talking, wanted everyone admiring his wealth and loyalty.
say:5:1721216004:1.source_cn: 至于联系新闻媒体的炒作，以及那场献宝仪式，也只是因为想...

say:7:1721216005:1.text: If we want the truth, we'll need to follow the transaction itself and see where it leads.
say:7:1721216005:1.source_cn: 具体情况还需要从霓光鲤的交易过程入手，进一步调查。
say:7:1721216005:1.male: If we want the truth, we'll need to follow the transaction itself and see where it leads.
say:7:1721216005:1.female: If we want the truth, we'll need to follow the transaction itself and see where it leads.

say:8:1721216006:0.text: Magister Merlin, here's the interrogation record on the transaction. Grandet gave us plenty to work with, and from the sound of it, <style="highlight">Count Ramir</style> may be tangled up in this as well...
say:8:1721216006:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下，这是有关交易过程的审讯记录。葛朗台男爵交代了...
say:8:1721216006:0.male: Magister Merlin, here's the interrogation record on the transaction. Grandet gave us plenty to work with, and from the sound of it, <style="highlight">Count Ramir</style> may be tangled up in this as well...
say:8:1721216006:0.female: Magister Merlin, here's the interrogation record on the transaction. Grandet gave us plenty to work with, and from the sound of it, <style="highlight">Count Ramir</style> may be tangled up in this as well...

say:9:1721216007:0.text: The written record is precise and formal, but even through all that official phrasing, you can practically hear Grandet blubbering through every line...
say:9:1721216007:0.source_cn: 这份记录以严谨的文字还原了审讯的现场。只是透过文字，你...
say:9:1721216007:0.male: The written record is precise and formal, but even through all that official phrasing, you can practically hear Grandet blubbering through every line...
say:9:1721216007:0.female: The written record is precise and formal, but even through all that official phrasing, you can practically hear Grandet blubbering through every line...

narration:11:1721216008:0.text: According to Grandet, this all started when he happened to pass by Silken Snare and spotted Count Ramir getting cozy with a woman...
narration:11:1721216008:0.source_cn: 据葛朗台所说，那天他路过丝绒陷阱时，偶然碰见了拉米尔伯...

narration:12:1721216009:0.text: Most people would have kept their heads down and kept moving. Grandet, apparently, is not most people.
narration:12:1721216009:0.source_cn: 常人都该知趣地回避，但葛朗台岂是走寻常路的贵族？

narration:13:1721216010:0.text: He'd been trying to worm his way into Ramir's social circle for ages. Never quite managed it, but that didn't stop him trying.
narration:13:1721216010:0.source_cn: 他崇拜伯爵的头衔，早就想与拉米尔结交，奈何总混不进他的社交圈

narration:14:1721216011:0.text: Grandet, naturally, took the encounter as a gift from fate and cautiously made his way over...
narration:14:1721216011:0.source_cn: 葛朗台将这次偶遇视作难得的机会，小心地凑了上去……

say:16:1721216012:1.text: That place, Silken Snare, is ridiculous. They literally turned away a paying customer!
say:16:1721216012:1.source_cn: 这个叫丝绒陷阱的餐厅真是奇怪，有生意都不做。

say:17:1721216013:1.text: I heard they serve some miracle dish that keeps you young. I was going to try it for you, you know.
say:17:1721216013:1.source_cn: 听说他们有道特殊的菜肴，吃了就能青春常驻。人家为了你，...

say:18:1721216014:1.text: And I couldn't get a table! I even used your name, and they still said no. Can you believe that?! Really, Ramir, you ought to do something about them...
say:18:1721216014:1.source_cn: 结果，连餐位都预约不上！报了你的名字都没用，你说他们讨...

say:20:1721216015:1.text: Behave yourself. And besides, didn't I make it up to you?
say:20:1721216015:1.source_cn: 不许胡闹。再说，我不是又补偿你了吗？

say:21:1721216016:1.text: Well? That soup I sent over, the one made from the neon carp. Worth the trouble, wasn't it?
say:21:1721216016:1.source_cn: 怎么样，用那条霓光鲤熬的汤还不错吧？

say:22:1721216017:1.text: More than worth it. Just look at me. The wrinkles are gone. I look in my twenties again.
say:22:1721216017:1.source_cn: 好得很哪。你瞧我的脸，之前的皱纹都消失不见了，好像回到...

say:23:1721216018:1.text: I thought you were spinning tales when you first mentioned it. I didn't expect it to actually work... So what exactly is this fish?
say:23:1721216018:1.source_cn: 之前听你说的，我还不信呢。没想到效果真的这么神奇……到...

say:24:1721216019:1.text: The fish carries magic in its flesh. It slows the body's decline, and the stronger the magic, the stronger the effect.
say:24:1721216019:1.source_cn: 这种鱼的体内蕴含魔力，能让人能让延缓衰老。体内蕴含魔力...

say:25:1721216020:0.text: The one you tasted was nothing remarkable. A true neon carp, one worthy of the name, can be prepared as medicine. One dose, and illness is swept away. The body restored to its prime!
say:25:1721216020:0.source_cn: 你的这条还算不上什么。真正的、能被称为“神鱼”的霓光鲤...

say:26:1721216021:1.text: So that "miracle dish" at Silken Snare... that's made from this fish?
say:26:1721216021:1.source_cn: 这么说，难道丝绒陷阱的那道特殊菜肴，就是用这种鱼做的？

say:27:1721216022:1.text: Now that would be a trade secret, wouldn't it? Not the sort of thing one shares with just anyone.
say:27:1721216022:1.source_cn: 呀……这算是商业机密了吧？这样天大的秘密，可千万不能告...

say:28:1721216023:1.text: Wouldn't you agree, sir? Since you've been lurking there and listening to every word.
say:28:1721216023:1.source_cn: 你说是吧，那位一直在偷听的先生？

say:32:1721216025:1.text: Baron Grandet, eavesdropping on a private conversation is hardly a polite way to introduce yourself.
say:32:1721216025:1.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵，你是在故意偷听我们谈话？这可不礼貌。

say:33:1721216026:1.text: No, no, Count Ramir, nothing like that. I wasn't eavesdropping. I just... I saw you two talking about that neon carp and... well, I was wondering whether it might be for sale.
say:33:1721216026:1.source_cn: 不、不！拉米尔伯爵，我绝没有偷听的意思。我是……是……...

say:34:1721216027:1.text: Oh? So that caught your attention. What is it, Baron, worried the years are finally starting to catch up to you?
say:34:1721216027:1.source_cn: 买鱼？呵呵……难不成男爵阁下也和我一样，有青春难驻的苦恼？

say:35:1721216028:1.text: Now, now, don't tease him. Baron Grandet has loftier concerns. Instead of worrying about wrinkles, he's always thinking of how to serve the royal court... isn't that right, Baron?
say:35:1721216028:1.source_cn: 不许胡说。葛朗台男爵日日都想着如何为王室分忧，成为一名...

say:36:1721216029:1.text: (The royal court... of course. If that fish really does what they say, then it could help the king...)
say:36:1721216029:1.source_cn: （王室……对了，我怎么没想到！能治百病的鱼，肯定也能治...

say:37:1721216030:1.text: ... Yes, exactly. That's why I came. I want the best neon carp you've got. The rarest one. The one that actually works miracles!
say:37:1721216030:1.source_cn: ……没错，拉米尔伯爵，我来找您，就是想求购那条最厉害、...

say:38:1721216031:1.text: That's not how this works! You don't just walk up and buy one. Even Ramir doesn't have extras lying around!
say:38:1721216031:1.source_cn: 不行！这鱼可不常见，就算是拉米尔手上也没有几条，哪里匀...

say:39:1721216032:1.text: Watch your tone, commoner! Who do you think you're talking to?!
say:39:1721216032:1.source_cn: 你、你——你不过就是个平民，竟敢对我如此无礼！

say:40:1721216033:1.text: Oh, do calm down, Baron Grandet. Why are you letting a girl get under your skin?
say:40:1721216033:1.source_cn: 好了，好了。葛朗台男爵，你和她生什么气？

say:41:1721216034:1.text: I'll be honest with you. The fish you're asking for—the one that can cure any illness—isn't in my possession right now. But I do happen to know where such a fish might be found.
say:41:1721216034:1.source_cn: 实话告诉你吧，吃了能让百病全消的那条霓光鲤，现在还不在...

say:42:1721216035:1.text: And I know why you're asking. Your loyalty to the royal family is plain to see. Believe me, Baron, I care about the court just as deeply.
say:42:1721216035:1.source_cn: 我知道你为什么想买霓光鲤——你对王室的忠心，我自然也有。

say:43:1721216036:1.text: The trouble, though, is the price. It's so expensive that even I had to stop and think twice.
say:43:1721216036:1.source_cn: 可这鱼的价格实在不便宜，即使是我，也可有些负担不起啊。

say:44:1721216037:1.text: Count, you know me. If there's even the slightest chance this could help His Majesty, then the price doesn't matter. Name it. I'll pay!
say:44:1721216037:1.source_cn: 哦，尊敬的伯爵大人！您是最了解我对王室的忠心的，无论多...

say:45:1721216038:1.text: Well, at the current market rate, that fish would cost you... <style="highlight">one million</style>.
say:45:1721216038:1.source_cn: 那条霓光鲤，目前的市场价是……<style=highl...

say:48:1721216041:1.text:
An astonishing figure, I know. But for a fish with that kind of power? And only one on the market? At that price, people would still fight over it.
Of course, if that's too much for you...
say:48:1721216041:1.source_cn: ——是啊，毕竟是药效如此神奇的霓光鲤，仅此一条。就算是...

say:49:1721216042:1.text: No, wait! I'll take it! I said I'd pay, and I will!

say:50:1721216043:0.text: Magnificent. Truly magnificent. Baron Grandet, your devotion does you credit! Very well. Since this is all in service of the royal court, I'll do you a favor and arrange the deal myself...
say:50:1721216043:0.source_cn: 不愧是以慷慨闻名的葛朗台男爵，这份忠心连我都为之惊叹！...

say:53:1721216044:0.text: And that, in Baron Grandet's own words, was how the whole deal happened.
say:53:1721216044:0.source_cn: 这就是葛朗台男爵交代的整个交易过程了。
say:53:1721216044:0.male: And that, in Baron Grandet's own words, was how the whole deal happened.
say:53:1721216044:0.female: And that, in Baron Grandet's own words, was how the whole deal happened.

choice_prompt:54:1721216044.female: And that, in Baron Grandet's own words, was how the whole deal happened.

say:55:1721216045:1.text: We've already found out where he lives in the upper district.
say:55:1721216045:1.source_cn: 是。我们已经查到了拉米尔伯爵在上城区的住址。
say:55:1721216045:1.male: We've already found out where he lives in the upper district.
say:55:1721216045:1.female: We've already found out where he lives in the upper district.

say:56:1721216046:1.text: Magister Merlin, come with me. We're not done yet, and I'd rather have you there for what comes next.
say:56:1721216046:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，请随我一同来吧。接下来的调查，也要麻烦您了。
say:56:1721216046:1.male: Magister Merlin, come with me. We're not done yet, and I'd rather have you there for what comes next.
say:56:1721216046:1.female: Magister Merlin, come with me. We're not done yet, and I'd rather have you there for what comes next.

choice:54:0:1.source_cn: 这个拉米尔伯爵很可疑

choice:54:1:2.text: Looks like he's our best lead.
choice:54:1:2.source_cn: 看来，他就是调查的突破口
choice:54:1:2.male: Looks like he's our best lead.
choice:54:1:2.female: Looks like he's our best lead.

choice:2:1:2.text: Shame. I thought I might make it in time.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 我还以为能赶上审讯过程呢
choice:2:1:2.male: Shame. I thought I might make it in time.
choice:2:1:2.female: Shame. I thought I might make it in time.
